The Cr12Ni12MnxFe76−x MEAs (x = 12, 16, 20 at%) were fabricated in a vacuum induction melting furnace in an Ar atmosphere. All elements used in the fabrication process had a purity of > 99.9%. The master alloy (50 g) was molten and cast into rectangular Cu molds (60 × 12 × 6 mm) and cooled by recirculating cooling water.
The cast ingots were homogenized at 1200 °C for 10 h, followed by air cooling.
Subsequently, the ingots were cold-rolled with a reduction ratio of 50%, followed by annealing at 1000 °C for 1 h and furnace-cooling.
